steps.tx: Excess prolactin suppressing GnRH and causing amenorrhoea with galactorrhoea is **hyperprolactinaemia**. Prolactinomas, drugs and hypothyroidism head the causes. A single non stressed morning sample usually suffices to detect it. Levels over 5000 milli international units per litre usually mean a macroadenoma rather than a drug effect.
steps.say: Hyperprolactinaemia suppresses GnRH causing amenorrhoea with galactorrhoea.

steps.tx: The preferred dopamine agonist with weekly dosing and better tolerance is **cabergoline**. It normalises prolactin and shrinks most prolactinomas without surgery. Bromocriptine is the older alternative preferred when conception is planned by some. It is taken twice weekly, and prolactin is rechecked after four weeks before dose changes.
steps.say: Cabergoline normalises prolactin weekly and shrinks most prolactinomas.

steps.tx: Intrauterine adhesions after curettage obliterating the cavity cause **Asherman syndrome**. Periods lighten or vanish despite normal hormones. Hysteroscopic division restores menstruation and fertility in most. Infertility with light periods after a postpartum curettage is the history that should trigger thoughts of it.
steps.say: Asherman syndrome scars the cavity after curettage despite normal hormones.

steps.tx: Macroprolactin, a biologically inactive big form, falsely elevates assays, termed **macroprolactin screening**. Laboratories precipitate it with polyethylene glycol on request. It explains high prolactin without symptoms or tumour. Testing for it is ordered when prolactin is high but the woman has no galactorrhoea or cycle change.
steps.say: Macroprolactin screening explains high prolactin without symptoms by inactive big forms.

steps.tx: Large prolactinomas compressing the optic chiasm cause bitemporal hemianopia needing **visual field testing**. MRI sizes the adenoma before treatment. Cabergoline usually shrinks even giant tumours dramatically. Goldmann perimetry charts the defect, and fields often recover within weeks as the tumour shrinks.
steps.say: Visual field testing guards large prolactinomas compressing the optic chiasm.

steps.tx: Pregnancy expands prolactinomas, so conception planning stops cabergoline at the positive test in microadenomas, following **pregnancy planning rules**. Macroadenomas may continue it. Visual symptoms in pregnancy earn urgent MRI without gadolinium. Bromocriptine is restarted if vision threatens, because it crosses to the fetus less in reported series than newer agents.
steps.say: Pregnancy planning stops cabergoline in microadenomas at the positive test.

steps.tx: Hysterosalpingogram or saline sonography outlines Asherman adhesions, but hysteroscopy both diagnoses and treats, termed **hysteroscopic adhesiolysis**. A balloon or coil prevents readhesion while oestrogen rebuilds lining. Repeat look procedures are common. Oestrogen after adhesiolysis is given for one to two cycles, often with a balloon stent for the first week.
steps.say: Hysteroscopic adhesiolysis treats Asherman adhesions with balloon prevention of recurrence.

steps.tx: Many raised prolactin results begin in the medicine chart, not the pituitary. The **drug cause pathway** runs through dopamine blockade: antipsychotics, metoclopramide and similar agents remove dopamine restraint on lactotrophs, so prolactin rises and periods stop. Stopping or switching the drug, where psychiatrically safe, normalises levels without scans or surgery. Checking the prescription list is therefore the first investigation in hyperprolactinaemia, before any imaging is requested.
steps.say: Dopamine blocking drugs raise prolactin by removing restraint on lactotrophs. Reviewing the prescription list is the first test in hyperprolactinaemia.

vis.alt: Pathway diagram of drug induced hyperprolactinaemia through dopamine receptor blockade.
vis.caption: A dopamine blocking drug is shown releasing prolactin secretion from pituitary restraint. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Drug induced hyperprolactinaemia from antipsychotics or metoclopramide needs psychiatric liaison before stopping, a **drug cause pathway**. Switching agents often normalises prolactin without dopamine agonists. Never add cabergoline blindly against prescribed antipsychotics. Risperidone is the antipsychotic most often blamed; aripiprazole can lower prolactin when a switch is possible.
steps.say: Drug cause pathways liaise with psychiatry before altering antipsychotic treatment.

steps.tx: Galactorrhoea with normal prolactin and regular cycles needs only reassurance, termed **idiopathic galactorrhoea**. Breast stimulation perpetuates it and is discouraged. Thyroid function completes its short workup. Thyroid stimulating hormone is the one other test, because hypothyroidism explains a share of these cases.
steps.say: Idiopathic galactorrhoea with normal prolactin needs only reassurance.
